title: Boundaries catch small mistakes
summary: A boundary is where a rule changes. Values just before, on and after it are especially useful tests.
introduction: A boundary is where a rule changes. Values just before, on and after it are especially useful tests. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A boundary is where a rule changes. Values just before, on and after it are especially useful tests.

blocks.code:
const canEnter = age => age >= 10;
console.log(canEnter(9), canEnter(10), canEnter(11));
blocks.title: Boundaries catch small mistakes

blocks.text: The output is false true true. Age 10 is allowed because the rule includes equality.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change >= to > and spot which case fails.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A greater-than sign and a greater-than-or-equal sign do different jobs.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
